book.name: 2 Timoteo
book.title: Pablo awentsaik carta agaja Timoteo awetimu

content: Tsawan nagkanbaunmash aentsush wajukua agtinaita nu pachisa tibau
Nuigtushkam jusha dekamainaitme: Tsawan nagkanbau agtina nuig, tsawan ishamain aidau midiagtinai.
Wagki aents aidauk imá nigki anenmamin, imá niinunak anentaimtin, eme anentaimtumin, emebau, pegkegchau chichagkagtin, apajin dukujinash intimjin, see tuchau, Apajuinash anentaimtuchu,
anejattsa diijatbaush atsujin, wait anenkagtuchu, kajemtin, chichaman tsanumin, ebetmamjachu, yajau, ashí pegkeg aidaun shiwagbau,
unumkagtin, esekachu, antakchau, Apajuinun nagkaesau niina shiig awagma nunak wekaetiagtin ainawai.
Apajuin shiig puyatjus umigna iman iwainmabiagtinai, tujash dita wajuk pujuinawa nu iwainatnai dekaskechua nuna. Aents nunin aina duka tupanjata.
Wagki nunú aina nuiyayai jega aidaunum wayawag, wainak nuwauch aidau tudaunak takainak iyashí ashí pegkegchaun wakega nuna takamtikin aidaun tsanú yujajin aina nu.
Nunú nuwa aidauk tuke unuimasagké ainawai, nuninakush dekaskea nunak tuke dekamainchau ainawai.

Janes Jambresjai Moisesan utugchatan aputusajua nunisag, nunú aents aidaush dekaskea nu etsegbaunum utugchatan apujuinawai. Ditak anentaimtajinig besekú, dekaskeapi tabaujinish tuke megkaegak megkaejau ainawai.
Tujash nunak nuigtuk emachagtinai, wagki ashí aents aidauk dita anentainkachu yujas nuní yujainamunak dekajuamu asag, nu jimag wajukawajua nunisag.

Tujash amek mina jintinkagtutaijua nu, mina pujutjua nu, wi takastasan anentaimtutaijua nu, dekaskeapi tutaijua dusha, wi waugtuchuitag nu, mina anenkag, utugchat katsuntanmash senchitag nu imatiksamek unuimajuitme,

mina waitkajuinamush, nuigtú wi waitiamujush. Nuigtush dekauwaitme wi Antioquía, Iconio, Listra aina nui waittsauwaitag dushakam; waitkajuinakui wajuk waitin ayaja nu, tujash ashí nunú aidaunmag Apu Jesús agkanmitkajuauwai.
Nunisag, ashí aents imá Cristo Jesusnak umijuinak pujustatus wakejuidaushkam, waitkam agtinai,
tujash aents pegkegchau aidau, nuigtú tsanumin aina dushakam nuní nagkaemas pegkegchaun takaagtinai, nuninak tsanubiagtinai ditash tsanuinamu asag.
Tujash amek, ashí unuimajuitam duke takastá, dekas nuninapi tiuwaitam nu. Amek dekame yanauwa unuimajuitme.
Amek uchuch asamek Agagbau Pegkegma duka dekauwaitme, nunú aina nuuwai Cristo Jesús dekaskeapi tabaunum uwemna nuna dekamtijamaina nunú.
Ashí Agagbauwa duka Apajuí tibauwa nuuwai, nunin asa atsumtaiyai jintinkagtamunum, anentai yapagkagtuata tabaunum, esekagtuata tabaunmash, pegkeg takat aina nui jintinkagtuata tabaunum,
Apajuí aentsji imagnis pujú ashí takat pegkeg aina nu takatnash shiig dekau atí tabaunum.
